thread.title: UPDATE: Dow Jones Industrial Average rebounds, powered by Nike and Microsoft

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Dow Jones Industrial Average rebounds, powered by Nike and Microsoft
text:
By Philip van Doorn, MarketWatch
Still, the blue-chip index is down 9.1% from its intraday record high on Jan. 26
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rebounded by 1.4% on Friday, with all but four of 30 companies rising. The gains were led by Nike.
The S&P 500 Index was up 1.5%, driven by Mattel.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at 24,190.90, producing a decline of 9.1% from its intraday record high of 26,616.71 on Jan. 26. The S&P 500 closed at 2,619.55 and was down 8.8% from its intraday record high of 2,872.87, also on Jan. 26.
